title: The assignments export lists one row per customer per person with Side
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-A} as its one representative; customer {Customer-B} shows Service Labor {Sales-rep-A} and Service Parts {Sales-rep-B}; customer {Customer-C} has {Sales-rep-C} as its one representative and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR One, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Two and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Three.
  • Starting screen: the page with the Sales Representative Assignments export is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Download the Sales Representative Assignments export.
  2. Find the column after "Representative is active?".
  3. Find the rows for {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a file named sales-representative-assignments.csv downloads.
  • Step 2: it is a column named "Side".
  • Step 3: {Customer-A}: one row, {Sales-rep-A}, Side "Parts and Service". {Customer-B}: two rows, {Sales-rep-A} "Service Labor" and {Sales-rep-B} "Service Parts". {Customer-C}: one row, {Sales-rep-C}, Side "Parts and Service, Part Sales".

The Sales By Representative spec, version 28 (12 Oct 2026, S15-R1, S15-R4, S15-R5 and S15-R9), names the export, its heading ("Rep is active?") and its Side values differently. Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 for the PRD (answers 17 and 18, quoted below); this case follows PRD version 10.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R23: “The "Sales Representative Assignments" export, file sales-representative-assignments.csv, lists one row per customer per person, with a column, Side, after "Representative is active?". The one representative of a customer that is not split reads "Parts and Service". A split customer lists "Service Labor" and "Service Parts". "Part Sales" is listed for the person in an added Part Sales field, split or not. A person in more than one field of one customer gets one row listing them in window order, separated by ", ", for example "Parts and Service, Part Sales".”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 17: “17. (a) as the feature spec: "Sales Representative Assignments", column "Representative is active?", Side after it; file name sales-representative-assignments.csv.”
  • Chris Ward's answer 18: “18. (a) as the feature spec.”
